messages.author: c0d23965d237c03d
messages.subject: error with gl.amova script?
parts:
Hi there,

I just started using dartR and was trying to run gl.amova on a SNP genlight file. I have successfully used other dartR code on the same set, but when I try gl.amova it it returns this error:

test_amova <- gl.amova(RAN, perm =100)

Error in amova(dist ~ pop.names, nperm = perm) : 
  unused argument (nperm = perm)


I'm not sure what is goinng on here, but any tips on how to side-step this error would be fantastic.


Cheers

messages.author: 25b837cc0a77be4e
messages.subject: error with gl.amova script?
parts:
I’m pretty sure it’s because you want to have permutations instead of perm in gl.amova

test_amova <- gl.amova(RAN, permutations =100)
